decisions.reason: The Demeter natural yogurt is a flagship extension of an established biodynamic range and fits the firm's organic positioning and trusted farmer relationships, so it is very likely kept.
The mild sliced cheese builds on in-house cheesemaking, serves steady organic retail demand, has its own product page, and is cheap to maintain alongside the existing cheese line.

The sliced butter cheese is a low-risk extension of the core cheese business with dedicated web presence, and one year is too early for an organic dairy firm to drop it, although overlap with the mild sliced cheese adds a little risk.
